prompt: Create an app icon sprite sheet with exactly 23 icons in the attached 24-square lattice. The canvas has exactly 4 columns and 6 rows. Every square occupies exactly 1/4 of the canvas width and 1/6 of its height: 256 by 256 pixels at the requested resolution. Fill the first 23 cells with the listed icons, left to right then top to bottom. The bottom-right square is deliberately unused: leave that entire square plain white, without any symbol. This blank square is the only permitted empty space; do not leave an entire row empty. Preserve all 24 square positions and boundaries exactly. Each occupied square has its specified solid-color background reaching all four edges and all four sharp 90-degree corners. Adjacent squares touch. NO rounded tile corners, gutters, padding, outer margins, footer, extra bands, captions, or exterior shadows. Replace all checkerboards and guide lines with the specified backgrounds. Use crisp white symbols with subtle internal depth. If output resolution differs, scale the entire lattice uniformly; do not change the canvas proportions or cell proportions.
